amendment_policy: numbered, hashed amendments; after any guarded access every amendment is posthoc, disclosed as an incident with both analyses reported

completion_constraints.residual: unfinished quantity is valued by walking the end-of-horizon book plus the registered 25 bps penalty; reported separately

cost_endpoints.bounded: under bounded replay every endpoint is an interval [optimistic, conservative]; a pairwise direction is historically identified only when both bounds agree in sign beyond the threshold
cost_endpoints.cvar90_is_bps: CVaR at level 0.90 of is_net_bps over the unit's registered windows (mean of the worst 10%, linear interpolation)
cost_endpoints.markout5s_bps: fill-weighted side x (mid at fill time + 5 s - fill price) / arrival mid x 1e4 over hypothetical passive fills (positive = favourable)
cost_endpoints.mean_is_bps: mean of is_net_bps over the unit's registered windows
cost_endpoints.primary: is_net_bps: side x (volume-weighted execution price incl. residual valuation - arrival mid) / arrival mid x 1e4 + registered fees (taker 5.5 bps on aggressive fills, maker 2.0 bps on passive fills) + 25 bps x unfilled fraction at the horizon (hard completion: policies cross at the deadline)
cost_endpoints.secondary: is_gross_bps (same without fees and penalty), completion, time to completion, participation

counterfactual_assumptions.identification: a pairwise direction is IDENTIFIED when the cost intervals separate on the unit; INDETERMINATE otherwise; nothing is an exact fill

grid_normalization.reason: the spot-format development day showed a 0.1 observed price precision against a registered 0.01 tick; a finer-than-observed tick would distort spread-in-ticks, visible-level and queue features
grid_normalization.registered_before: any explore, confirm or final access
grid_normalization.rule: the price grid used is the coarser of the registered tick and the archive's observed decimal price precision (first 2000 messages); the size grid is the finer of the registered lot and the observed size precision; every difference is recorded as a known anomaly in the dataset's quality report

fees.note: registered retail-tier fees; costs are reported gross and net of fees separately

mandates.quantity_rule: notional / arrival mid, rounded down to the lot size
mandates.side_rule: buy on even registered windows, sell on odd windows
mandates.windows: 24 per day starting at HH:10:00 UTC (HH = 0..23), each with a 30 s warmup

data_quality.gap_rule: a sequence gap invalidates the book until the next snapshot

evidence_levels.E6: cross-time real support on fresh data
evidence_levels.E7: cross-instrument real support on fresh data
evidence_levels.E8: cross-venue real support on fresh data

excluded_dates.2025-09-20: v0.9 Bybit spot BTCUSDT format day (development access)

firewall.rule: dates on or before consumed_through and the excluded dates are never fresh; one date belongs to one v1 pool across every stream

mbo_pools.rule: complete UTC capture days of the prospective Bitstamp capture (>= 95% of seconds covered by COMPLETE segments, at least two censuses), in calendar order from 2026-10-26: days 1-5 explore, days 6 onward confirm (registered maximum 16 confirm days); no capture day is ever reassigned

promotion_rules.direct_replication: H1-H12, H45, H46, H48 are promoted without pilot-dependent selection; their confirm cluster count is fixed here (12 dates); pilots inform only feasibility reporting
promotion_rules.frozen_before: any v1 pilot outcome is read
promotion_rules.no_split_half_screen: v0.9 amendment 3 is not carried; neither split-half statistic is used
promotion_rules.pilot: every other candidate is promoted iff (a) its required capabilities exist in the registered pools, (b) an exploratory pilot on >= 6 explore date clusters exists, (c) the planning effect (pilot cluster mean - 1 cluster SE, oriented) exceeds the practical threshold, (d) cluster-t power at the planning effect is >= 0.8 with G <= the pool's primaries and G >= min_clusters, and (e) expected compute is within the ceiling

realism_gate.acceptable: the generator's metric lies inside the reference band for every metric of the capability and the real-vs-generated classifier AUC <= 0.65
realism_gate.fail_closed: a REJECTED capability never supports a claim that needs it
realism_gate.frozen: thresholds are never moved to create an ACCEPTABLE generator
realism_gate.partial: every metric within twice the band half-width of the band centre
realism_gate.reference: per metric, the 5-95% range of the same metric over the calibrate-pool days (>= 8 real days), widened by the metric's bootstrap SE on the test day; the 4-day pair reference of v0.9 is retired

research_question: Do the v0.9 conclusions replicate independently on genuinely fresh market data under correct date clustering, and can repaired and new generator families reproduce observed dynamics and execution-decision rankings under frozen capability-specific criteria?

resources.on_exceed: RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED; checkpoints kept; budget changes need an amendment before outcome inspection

statistics.equivalence: TOST with the registered margin on cluster-t intervals
statistics.heterogeneity: per-stream means and a date x stream two-way cluster interval are reported, not decided
statistics.independent_unit: calendar date; values of the streams of one date form one cluster
statistics.interval: two-sided 95% cluster-t interval of the mean (reported with every estimate)
statistics.primary_test: cluster_t: one-sided test of H0 mean <= threshold with the CR1 cluster-robust SE, Student t on G - 1 df; Holm within the registered family at alpha 0.05
statistics.secondary_test: exact cluster sign-flip of (value - threshold); ESTABLISHED requires both the primary Holm rejection and the sign-flip p <= the same Holm-adjusted alpha

terminal_rule.FAILED: the upper 95% cluster-t bound lies below the threshold (effect below practical size)
terminal_rule.NOT_AVAILABLE: registered data unavailable after every backup
terminal_rule.NOT_ESTABLISHED: not promoted (never tested on guarded data)
terminal_rule.NOT_EVALUABLE: a registered precondition is unmet (e.g. H47 without an accepted generator)

statistics.transfer: every carried conclusion meets its threshold (Holm over the conclusions)
statistics.transfer_any: at least one carried conclusion meets its threshold (Holm over the conclusions)
